# Gitleaks sidekiq-sensitive-url: invented provider-shaped values. Fixtures
# are excluded from secret scanning, so shapes stay realistic. The host must
# be followed by /, #, ? or :, so values carry a trailing slash as in a
# Gemfile source line.
# ruleid: sidekiq-sensitive-url
source https://abcdef12:345678ab@gems.contribsys.com/
# ruleid: sidekiq-sensitive-url
source https://12345678:abcdefab@enterprise.contribsys.com/
# ok: sidekiq-sensitive-url
source = "example"
# ok: sidekiq-sensitive-url
source = "placeholder"
